properties.title: Pelguranna – Putukaväil to Kolde pst
properties.description: Branch of the Kopli line from the Krulli stop through the former Kopli goods-station railway corridor and the Putukaväil linear park, across Sõle, to a loop at Kolde puiestee. Route approved by the city government on 18 February 2026; EU funding confirmed by the state on 23 November 2026.
properties.geometry_note: Beyond Sõle the approved route runs in the Putukaväil corridor behind the Puhangu garages, which has no mapped street. The parallel part of Puhangu street, up to 100 m away, stands in for it; the terminus is placed at the Puhangu tn 45 property named in the city's decision.
properties.published_note: €27.9M with up to €19.5M ERDF (state decision, Nov 2026); city ridership estimate 6,498 per day.
properties.study_2019_note: Appraised as corridor 9B, Pelguranna – Kopli tn, on the Puhangu alignment of 2019; the route funded in 2026 differs.

properties.title: Pelguranna – Puhangu to Stroomi park
properties.description: The alignment designed until 2025: the same railway corridor from Krulli across Sõle, then along Puhangu street in the carriageway to a loop by Stroomi beach park at the Pelguranna street end.
properties.published_note: €28M to more than €33M (city note, 2025; midpoint shown); ridership estimate 6,200 per day.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 9B, Pelguranna – Kopli tn.

properties.title: Sõle – Kristiine to Kopli line
properties.description: Corridor 15 of the 2019 study: from the Endla railway viaduct at Kristiine along Madara and Sõle to the Kopli line at the Maleva stop. Ranked in the first stage in 2019; no project since.
properties.published_note: €19.2M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices); 33,409 residents within 500 m per the study.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 15, Kopli tn – Kristiine.

properties.title: Kalaranna – Tööstuse to Kopli
properties.description: Corridor 9A of the 2019 study: from the existing track at Linnahall along Kalaranna, past Lennusadam and along Tööstuse to Kopli street. The 2022 street-space study drew only the first part, to a loop at Lennusadam.
properties.published_note: €18.0M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices); 14,199 residents within 500 m per the study.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 9A, Kopli tn – Mere pst.

properties.title: Liivalaia – Pärnu mnt to Tartu mnt
properties.status_label: Designed 2024–25, abandoned by the coalition in December 2025
properties.description: Stage 1 as designed: double track along Liivalaia between the Pärnu mnt / Suur-Ameerika junction and the Tartu mnt junction, joining the existing tracks at both ends. Ranked highest-potential in 2022 and chosen for EU funding in 2024; the 2025 coalition agreement dropped it.
properties.published_note: No separate length or cost published; the EU grant for the Liivalaia track was about €15.5M.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 10A, Koidu tn – Tuukri tn, which is longer than this option at both ends.

properties.title: Kristiine – Endla, Suur-Ameerika, Liivalaia
properties.status_label: Full 2022 alignment; shelved with the Liivalaia tram
properties.description: The full Tehnika–Liivalaia alignment of the 2022 study: from the Endla / Tehnika junction by the railway viaduct (Kristiine hub) along Endla and Suur-Ameerika to Liivalaia and on to Tartu mnt. In 2026 the deputy mayor called a version of this, in a cutting, "not buried".
properties.published_note: Corridor 10A of the 2019 study: 3.2 km and €22.2M (2019 prices), but that corridor ends via Pronksi at Jõe rather than at Tartu mnt.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 10A, Koidu tn – Tuukri tn. The Kristiine – Koidu link is appraised separately (corridor 99: €6.7M, BCR 6.9 / 5.3 / 7.8 / 6.3).

properties.title: Kristiine – Kaarli pst, Estonia pst, Gonsiori
properties.status_label: Alternative from the 2025 analysis and the draft Kesklinn plan
properties.description: East–west link through the centre instead of Liivalaia: from Kristiine along Endla, Tõnismägi and Kaarli puiestee to Vabaduse väljak, then Estonia puiestee to the existing track on Gonsiori. Proposed by the 2025 K-Projekt analysis; similar to corridor 10B of the 2019 study.
properties.published_note: Corridor 10B of the 2019 study (ending via Kentmanni and Rävala): 2.3 km, €9.7M (2019 prices).
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 10B, Koidu tn – Rävala extension, which ends via Kentmanni and Rävala rather than Gonsiori.

properties.title: Järve – Tondi to Järve keskus
properties.status_label: Planned in SUMP 2035; no decision or funding
properties.description: Extension of the Pärnu mnt track from the Tondi junction along Pärnu maantee, over the railway viaduct and past Järvevana tee, to a loop at Järve keskus. Named by the city in 2026 as an example of a stepwise extension with the new bidirectional trams.
properties.published_note: Corridor 6A of the 2019 study: 2.2 km, €13.8M (2019 prices).
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 6A, Järve – Tondi.

properties.title: Lasnamäe – Narva mnt and the Rahu tee corridor
properties.status_label: Study corridor (2019); named as a candidate in 2026
properties.description: Extension of the Kadriorg line from the J. Poska stop along Narva maantee up to Lasnamäe and on through the planned Rahu tee corridor to Priisle, ending at the Ussimäe tee stops (corridor 2A' of the 2019 study, its preferred northern Lasnamäe variant). Rahu tee is not built, so the line follows the corridor as the city has drawn it from the study.
properties.geometry_note: Follows the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors, not the street network: most of the Rahu tee corridor has no street yet.
properties.published_note: 2019 study: Russalka – Lasnamäe end €35.6M plus Poska – Russalka €4.1M (2019 prices); 7.2 km is given for variant 2A.
properties.study_2019_note: Appraised as Russalka – Lasnamäe end (2A / 2A' / 3A+). The Poska – Russalka link is appraised separately (corridor 98: €4.1M, BCR 6.6 / 5.0 / 7.7 / 6.1).

properties.title: Lasnamäe – Narva mnt, Lavamaa, Läänemere tee
properties.status_label: Study variant (2019), judged too tight between buildings
properties.description: Extension of the Kadriorg line from the J. Poska stop along Narva maantee up to Lasnamäe, then Lavamaa, Paasiku and Läänemere tee to Priisle (corridor 2A of the 2019 study). The study prefers a variant in the planned Rahu tee corridor (the option above).
properties.published_note: 2019 study: Russalka – Lasnamäe end €35.6M plus Poska – Russalka €4.1M (2019 prices), 7.2 km.
properties.study_2019_note: Appraised together with 2A' as Russalka – Lasnamäe end; the study drops this variant as too tight between buildings.

properties.title: Lasnamäe – Gonsiori and Laagna tee
properties.status_label: Study corridor (2019); trolleybus chosen for Laagna tee
properties.description: Corridor 3A of the 2019 study with its Gonsiori connector: from the existing track at A. Laikmaa along Gonsiori and the Laagna tee cutting to Mustakivi tee. The city has since chosen battery trolleybuses for this corridor (in service 2029–2030).
properties.published_note: 2019 study: Laagna tee 6.9 km €37.8M plus Gonsiori connector 1.6 km €8.6M (2019 prices); 77,315 residents within 500 m of the Laagna tee part.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 3A, Laagna tee. The Gonsiori connector is appraised separately (corridor 17, Laikmaa – Laagna tee: €8.6M, BCR 6.2 / 4.9 / 7.0 / 5.7).

properties.title: Mustamäe – Sõpruse pst to Ehitajate tee
properties.description: Corridor 7A of the 2019 study: from the Kristiine hub along Endla and Sõpruse puiestee to the Ehitajate tee junction. Current city policy is trolleybuses on this corridor.
properties.published_note: 5.0 km in the 2019 study; cost published only together with corridor 7B (€48.6M, 2019 prices).
properties.study_2019_note: Appraised together with 7B as 'Akadeemia tee, Sõpruse pst and lines inside Mustamäe'; cost and value cover more than this option.

properties.title: Haabersti – Paldiski mnt
properties.status_label: Study corridor (2019); trolleybus chosen for Paldiski mnt
properties.description: Corridor 8A of the 2019 study as far as Haabersti: from the Kristiine hub to Paldiski maantee and along it to the Haabersti junction. The study does not name the streets between Kristiine and Paldiski mnt; Tehnika is used here. Trolleybus infrastructure on Paldiski mnt is in the 2027 budget.
properties.published_note: 2019 study: Kristiine – Paldiski mnt – Haabersti €23.4M (2019 prices); length not stated separately.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 8A, section Haabersti – Kristiine.

properties.title: Mustamäe – Tammsaare tee, Järvevana tee to Ülemiste
properties.description: Corridor 11 of the 2019 study as it was kept after the first modelling round: from Mustamäe along A. H. Tammsaare tee and Järvevana tee to Ülemiste and the airport, a direct link between Mustamäe and Ülemiste that does not pass the centre. The study dropped the part from Haabersti along Ehitajate tee (under 5,000 passengers a day).
properties.from_label: end of line 24 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: start of line 24 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 24), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: €43.1M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices). The 10.2 km and 48,614 residents within 500 m in the study text include the dropped Haabersti – Ehitajate tee part.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 11, 'Tammsaare tee, Järvevana tee, Mustamäe tee branch'.

properties.title: City centre – Juhkentali, Odra to Laagna tee
properties.description: Corridor 12 of the 2019 study: from Liivalaia along Juhkentali to the bus station and on by Odra and K. Türnpu to the start of Laagna tee. It joins the Liivalaia and Laagna tee corridors into a direct Mustamäe – Lasnamäe line south of the centre.
properties.from_label: start of line 10 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: start of line 10 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 10), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: €9.8M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices). The study text gives 0.4 km for the new street section only and 21,378 residents within 500 m.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 12, Liivalaia – Laagna tee.

properties.title: City centre – Toompuiestee, Tõnismägi to Balti jaam
properties.description: Corridor 14 of the 2019 study: along Toompuiestee between Tõnismägi and Balti jaam, on the west side of the Old Town. Its purpose is to close a tram ring around the centre.
properties.from_label: start of line 25 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: end of line 25 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 25), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: 1.9 km and €10.1M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices).
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 14, Tõnismägi – Balti jaam.

properties.title: Uuslinn and Sikupilli – Narva mnt to Majaka
properties.description: Corridor 18A' of the 2019 study: from Narva maantee by Valge and Pallasti to Majaka and the existing track at Sikupilli. It links the Pirita and northern Lasnamäe lines with Ülemiste. Variant 18A through Pae park was dropped in favour of 18A'.
properties.from_label: end of line 13 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: start of line 13 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 13), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: 2.4 km (given for variant 18A) and €12.7M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices); 15,611 residents within 500 m per the study.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 18A / 18A', Narva mnt – Majaka tn.

properties.title: Väike-Õismäe and Astangu – Haabersti to Astangu
properties.description: Corridor 8B of the 2019 study: a branch of the Paldiski maantee line from the Haabersti junction along Ehitajate tee, the western arc of Õismäe tee and Järveotsa tee to Astangu.
properties.from_label: start of line 18 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: end of line 18 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 18), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: 3.8 km and €20.8M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices); 44,513 residents within 500 m together with the Paldiski mnt section of corridor 8A.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 8B, Astangu – Paldiski mnt.

properties.title: Mustamäe to Väike-Õismäe – Akadeemia tee
properties.description: Corridor 7B of the 2019 study: the end part of the Mustamäe line, along Akadeemia tee to the Järveotsa tee junction. It joins Mustamäe with Väike-Õismäe and the Astangu branch, which the study says raises passenger numbers on both.
properties.from_label: start of line 21 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: end of line 21 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 21), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: 2.0 km in the 2019 study; 19,136 residents within 500 m. Cost published only together with corridor 7A (€48.6M, 2019 prices).
properties.study_2019_note: Appraised together with 7A as 'Akadeemia tee, Sõpruse pst and lines inside Mustamäe'; cost and value cover far more than this option.

properties.title: Järve to Mustamäe – Tervise
properties.description: Corridor 6B of the 2019 study: continues the Järve extension (6A) from Järve west along Tervise to Sõpruse puiestee, joining the Pärnu maantee line with the Mustamäe line past the North Estonia Medical Centre.
properties.from_label: start of line 32 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: end of line 32 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 32), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: €9.2M infrastructure for 'Tervise tn and extension, from Sõpruse pst' (2019 study, 2019 prices). The 2.7 km in the study text runs on to Mustamäe tee, a part dropped with variant 7A'. 34,804 residents within 500 m of 6A and 6B together.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 6B, Tervise tn and extension from Sõpruse pst.

properties.title: Ülemiste City – Valukoja
properties.description: Corridor 97 of the 2019 study: an extension of the existing track into the Ülemiste City business district along Valukoja, from Keevise to Kesk-Sõjamäe. The study ties its timing to how fast the eastern part of the district is built.
properties.from_label: end of line 26 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: start of line 26 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 26), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: 1.1 km and €4.6M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices).
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 97, extension inside Ülemiste.

properties.title: Lasnamäe industrial area – Peterburi tee
properties.description: Corridor 4 of the 2019 study: an extension of the Tartu maantee line from Suur-Paala east along Peterburi tee towards Vesse. The study asks for denser building along it before it is worth building.
properties.from_label: start of line 30 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.to_label: end of line 30 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 30), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: €7.2M infrastructure (2019 study, 2019 prices); the study states no length.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 4, Peterburi tee section.

properties.title: Pirita – Pirita tee and Merivälja tee (Viimsi line, part in Tallinn)
properties.description: The part inside Tallinn of corridor 1 of the 2019 study, the Viimsi line: from Narva maantee at Russalka along Pirita tee and through Pirita to the city boundary at Merivälja. The corridor continues to Haabneeme in Viimsi municipality, which this analysis cannot measure, so reach is counted for the Tallinn part only.
properties.from_label: start of line 9 in the city's drawing of the 2019 study corridors
properties.geometry_note: Taken from the city's published drawing of the 2019 study corridors (line 9), not routed on the street network.
properties.published_note: The study gives 10.6 km and €54.3M (2019 prices) for the whole line to Haabneeme, and 11,279 residents within 500 m.
properties.study_2019_note: Corridor 1, Russalka – Viimsi (Lubja): cost and value are for the whole line, about a quarter of which lies outside Tallinn.
